verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a hosted document-parsing SaaS, but the evidence documents no retention settings, deletion APIs, or retention windows. Self-hosting/BYOC (keeping data 'under your control'), SOC 2, HIPAA/BAA and regional endpoints are adjacent privacy-posture features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
